literal_meaning: শেষ রক্ষা (last protection or final safeguard)
figurative_meaning_en: Managing the final crisis successfully; achieving a happy or auspicious conclusion
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঝড়ের রাতে বিয়েটা মিটতে শেষরক্ষা হ'ল।
পরীক্ষার শেষ মুহূর্তে সে শেষরক্ষা করতে পারল।
example_sentences_in_english: In the stormy night, the wedding ended with a last safeguard.
At the last moment of the exam, he managed a final rescue.
note: Often used in contexts of weddings or events facing last-minute troubles in traditional Bengali settings.
